Roo and Cal explicitly OPTIONAL with substitution path; NO-MATERIALS body-math alternative (pace perimeter, sit in rows, carpet-circle capacity, body-clock pose) anchors instructional_balance at 4. Capstone refrain 'Measure AROUND, measure the FILL, measure the TIME!' with class call-and-response chant 3x in exit_routine. Action step 6 STRATEGY COMPARE has two children share perimeter strategies and class debates efficiency, citing Earnest (2017) on time+space integration — this is the invent-and-compare move that lifts mathematical_authenticity to 4. Worksheet Parts 1-3 mirror lesson stations; Part 4 'Pick the Tool' is a deliberate transfer task (attribute-to-tool matching across length/area/time/mass) justified in teacher_notes. Timing 12/25/13 = 50 min is realistic for G3.
